package bad

// Negative examples for TestDiscardGuardFlagsNegativeExample (kept as .txt so the
// compiler and the production walk never see it). Each function marked blank*
// throws away a helper's error and must be flagged; the others must not be.

func blankData(p string) []byte {
	data, _ := readFile(p)
	return data
}

func blankOnly() {
	_ = cachedJSON("k", nil, nil)
}

func blankInIf(p string) bool {
	if _, _ = readFile(p); true {
		return true
	}
	return false
}

func blankViaSource() []byte {
	b, _ := curSource().Cached("k", nil)
	return b
}

func handled(p string) []byte {
	data, err := readFile(p)
	if err != nil {
		return nil
	}
	return data
}

func namedErr(p string) error {
	_, err := readFile(p)
	return err
}

func unrelatedCall() int {
	n, _ := somethingElse()
	return n
}
